programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Lon le Linda
programme.desc: Anns a’ phrògram seo tha Alexia agus Scarlett còmhla rithe ‘s iad ag ullachadh sgonaichean le càise agus coirce. Ach mus tòisich iad, feumaidh iad a bhith cinnteach gu bheil an stuth a tha a dhìth orra a-staigh. Mur a bheil, bidh iad a’ dèanamh liosta agus a’ dol dhan bhùth airson a h-uile càil fhaighinn. Bidh Linda agus a caraidean cuideachd a’ faighinn a-mach cò às a tha coirce a’ tighinn. Tha iad an uairsin a’ tilleadh dhan chidsin airson na sgonaichean a dheasachadh mus suidh iad sìos aig a’ bhòrd gan ithe. Linda is joined by Alexia and Scarlett to make delicious cheese and oat scones. Before they start cooking, they have to ensure they have all the ingredients. If not, they make a list and go shopping. They also learn more about where oats come from, and then they return to the kitchen to make the scones before sitting down at the table to eat them.

programme.title: Oscar & Ealasaid
programme.desc: Tha rud ma seach a’ dol air dhìth anns a’ bhaile: an leabhar sgrìobhaidh aig Ealasaid, an ad aig Maoileas Mòr, a’ phrosbaig aig Leitidh Lilidh, agus fiù ’s…an cleòca aig an Luchag Uaine! Dè idir a tha a’ dol air adhart? More and more objects are disappearing in town: Célestine's notebook, Boléro's hat, Mrs Tupile's binoculars, and even… the Green Mouse's cape! What's going on here?

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha Àtaidh agus Tilidh a’ cur cafaidh air chois. Tha uallach orra nach tig duine dhan chafaidh aca, ach chan fheum uallach sam bith a bhith orra! Abney and Teal decide to set up a café. They're worried about not getting any customers, but they have no reason to be concerned.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Thig air sgrìob eile cuide ri na h-Abadas 's iad ri tuilleadh spors 's ploigh aba-doo-bee-dee fhad 's a tha iad air toir an fhacal 'glainne-meudachaidh'. Ela is very tired today, but is she too exhausted to play the word game? Join the Abadas as one of them heads off for another aba-doo-be-dee island adventure to find today's word, 'magnifying glass'.

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Nuair a tha an clas a' faighinn cothrom turas campachaidh bhith aca, tha Stella, ‘s i na h-eòlaiche na beachd fhèin, airson 's gun tèid i fhèin, Mia is Freya, 'son practas sa ghàrradh an toiseach – ach saoil am bi seo soirbheachail? When the class gets the chance to go on a camping trip, Stella, who’s an expert in her own opinion, wants to practise in the garden with Mia and Freya - but will this be successful?

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Ged a tha Stella cleachdte ri bhith bruidhinn air beulaibh dhaoine, ‘s e rud eile a th’ ann a h-òraid a sgrìobhadh dhi fhèin cuideachd. Tha i fortanach gu bheil deagh charaidean aice, ge-tà! Although Stella is used to public speaking, it’s another thing altogether to have to write her own speech, too. She’s fortunate to have good friends though.

programme.title: Uaine
programme.desc: Tha uisge pailt ann an Alba agus tha Calum air a’ Ghàidhealtachd far a bheil e a’ tadhal air Stèisean Cumhachd Foithir agus a’ coinneachadh ri fear de na seann tunnel tigers aig Dam Chluanaidh airson ionnsachadh mu chumhachd hydro. Water is rarely in short supply in Scotland and Calum is in the Highlands. He visits Foyers Power Station and meets a tunnel tiger at Cluanie Dam to learn more about hydroelectric power.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Is caomh le Tòmas a bhith cur seachad ùine le crodh. Tha e mar gu bheil iad dha thuigsinn. Nuair a tha droch là aige san sgoil, thig iad thuige is bruidhnidh e riutha. Tha e airson a bhith na bhuachaille nuair a dh’fhàsas e mòr. Tòmas loves to spend time with cows - they seem to understand him. When he’s had a bad day at school, they come to him and he talks to them. He wants to be a herdsman when he grows up.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Murchadh MacPhàrlain: Bard Mhealboist
programme.desc: Tha na facail aig Murachadh MacPharlain rin cluinntinn air bilean ginealach as deidh ginealach , rud a tha fios a bheireadh toileachas dhan duine uasal seo a bha cho ladair na sheasamh a thaobh canan agus cultar nan Gaidheal. B'e techneolas gu ire mhor a dh'fhag gun thachair sin agus an inneal-claraidh a' fagail gum b'urrain na facail agus na fuinn aige a' sgaoileadh na b' fharsainge. Tha am program seo a'deanamh dealbh air an duine agus a bhuaidh a th'aige fhathast air beatha nan Gaidheal. Award-winning documentary profiling Murdo MacFarlane, the Melbost Bard and renowned Gaelic poet and songwriter from the island of Lewis, whose work was a catalyst for a whole new era of modern Gaelic music. Having composed poems and songs all his life, it was not until the advent of the tape recorder that Murdo, who could neither read nor write music, became known to a wider audience. Featuring TV and radio archive recordings of Murdo being interviewed and performances of his work.

programme.title: Mach à Seo!
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon heads off on a trip through Dalbeattie and Lockerbie. He learns about the area’s granite industry, samples a local delicacy and becomes a farmer for the afternoon.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Às dèidh toiseach tòiseachaidh dùbhlanach, lean Somhairle agus Innes orra a’ rothaireachd air a Bhadger Divide, far an tàinig iad tarsainn air duilgheadasan meacanaigeach; uisge trom; geàrr-rathaidean; tionndadh ceàrr agus bagannan caillte! Thàinig an rothaiche agus an neach-gleidhidh chlàran, Kerry Nic a’Phì, còmhla riutha airson earrann. After a tough start, Somhairle and Innes continue riding the Badger Divide, where they encounter mechanical issues, torrential rain, shortcuts, wrong turns and lost baggage! They’re joined for a section by record-holder, cyclist Kerry MacPhee.

programme.title: Suas gu Deas
programme.desc: Tha fèill a chruidh ann a Loch na Madadh, tha Còisir Ghàidhlig Bharraigh air an àrd-urlar aig Mòd Loch Abar agus tha ròlaist neo dhà aig a Chidsin Cèilidh ann an Uibhist a Deas! Crofters select their best calves and cattle for market, we drop in on the popular kitchen ceilidh in South Uist, and Barra Gaelic Choir compete at the Lochaber Mod. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Port Steòrnabhaigh
programme.desc: Based in the main port in the Hebrides, we follow the beating hearts of Stornoway Harbour. In her shelter, there is a bustling community to be found. In this final episode, we mark a historic day for the Hebrides as the first cruise ship has arrived at the Deep Water Terminal, and tourists get a chance to visit some of the island’s top attractions. Stèidhte ann am prìomh port nan Eilean Siar, the sinne a’ leantainn cridhe Port Steòrnabhaigh. Na fasgadh, tha coimhearsnachd trang ri lorg. Anns a’ phrògram mu dheireadh, tha sinn a’ comharrachadh là eachdraidheil anns na h-eileanan le fàilte air a’ chiad bhàta-crùis aig Cala Domhain Steòrnabhaigh, agus gheibh an luchd-siubhail cothrom a dhol gu feadhainn de phrìomh làraich nan Eilean. Thig còmhla rinn ‘s sinn a’ leanntainn beatha ann am Port Steòrnabhaigh.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Featuring composers and performers Marit & Rona, and the exciting Kinnaris Quinte make their second Seirm Celtic Connections appearance.

programme.title: Rocaidean gu Leor (Rockets Galore)
programme.desc: Tha fanas a’ toirt buaidh mhòr air ar beatha laitheil, gu h-àraid a thaobh teicneolas. Tha luach na builleanan de notaicean an gnìomhachas an fhanais agus tha Alba air aon de na dùthchanan a thana theis-mheadhain. Thigibh còmhla ri Mairi Rodgers ’s i a coinneachadh ri daoine a tha a’dèanamh rocaidean mar chur-seachad, oileanaich a tha airson obair fhaighinn sa ghniomhachais agus cuid de na companaidhean a tha a’ sas ann. Bidh I cuideachd a tadhal air coimhearnsnachdan far a bheil feadhainn gu mòr ag iarraidh port-fanais san nabachd aca agus feadhainn eile gu tur na aghaidh. Space massively impacts our daily lives, especially in the technology that we use. The industry is worth billions of pounds and Scotland is one of the countries at the heart of that industry. Join Mairi Rodgers as she meets amateur rocketeers, students who hope to work in the industry and some of the companies involved. She also visits communities where spaceports are planned - with some warmly embracing the hubs and others determined to block them.

programme.title: An Cruinne Caochlaideach/Dynamic Planet
programme.desc: As the planet heats up, those fighting climate change show how science, nature and tradition can prepare us for the future.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Tide Lines a’ tilleadh chun na fèise mu dheireadh thall, le Fiona NicChoinnich is Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilt’ air a’ chòmhlan gu Àrd-Ùrlar Hot House. A’ toirt Glasgow Love Story gu Gàidhealtachd na h-Alba, tha an còmhlan a’ toirt thugainn òrain ùra air leth agus feadhainn aosta air a bheil meas mòr, le sluagh ceòlmhor aig Belladrum 2025. Tide Lines make a much-anticipated return to the festival as Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald welcome the band to the Hot House Stage. Bringing their Glasgow Love Story to the Scottish Highlands, the group perform exciting new tracks and beloved hits with their fans in full voice.

programme.title: Life on Earth
programme.desc: Bright blue starfish, crimson feather stars, shell-less snails in designs as extravagant as any Paris fashion show, shrimps of every colour, others that are transparent - just a sample of the animal wonders to be found in a small area of the Great Barrier Reef.

programme.title: Voyages of Discovery
programme.desc: Explorer Paul Rose reveals the real story behind the first ever circumnavigation of the world. Ferdinand Magellan set out 500 years ago to find the westward route to the riches of the Spice Islands. But, contrary to popular perception, he never reached them. Rose explains the dramatic sequence of events that led his scurvy-riddled crew to continue around the world without him. The incredible expedition was laced with bloody mutiny and murder, but its achievement was to fundamentally change the lives of the generations that followed, influencing life even today.

programme.title: Goolagong

programme.title: Life on Earth
programme.desc: Bright blue starfish, crimson feather stars, shell-less snails in designs as extravagant as any Paris fashion show, shrimps of every colour, others that are transparent - just a sample of the animal wonders to be found in a small area of the Great Barrier Reef.

programme.title: Voyages of Discovery
programme.desc: Explorer Paul Rose reveals the real story behind the first ever circumnavigation of the world. Ferdinand Magellan set out 500 years ago to find the westward route to the riches of the Spice Islands. But, contrary to popular perception, he never reached them. Rose explains the dramatic sequence of events that led his scurvy-riddled crew to continue around the world without him. The incredible expedition was laced with bloody mutiny and murder, but its achievement was to fundamentally change the lives of the generations that followed, influencing life even today.

programme.title: Goolagong
programme.desc: Grieving for her father, Evonne rebuilds her life, fires Vic, marries Roger and overcomes injury to win Wimbledon as a mother in a historic victory.

programme.title: Scrublands
programme.desc: At teenager Allen's wake, Martin learns that the boy was not as innocent as first portrayed, with Robbie telling him he was persuaded by Byron Swift to drop minor drug charges against him. Martin is given reason to believe that Sgt Piccini could be right in thinking that her investigation is being thwarted from above.

programme.title: Scrublands
programme.desc: Martin believes he has found the link between the shooting victims and asks for Robbie’s help in accessing the case files. A further clue implicates one of the victims as being behind the murder of the missing couple, and young Jamie admits he has been keeping a horrible secret from everybody.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances

programme.title: Tech Now
programme.desc: Andrew Rogers visits a former quarry where new tech is being tested to help people stay underwater for longer. Joe Tidy reports on a huge U-turn for big tech as Instagram stops end-to-end encryption. Franchesca Hashemi explains what you need to know about the lithium-ion batteries in the tech you use every day. And Nick Kwek meets the tech entrepreneur trying to decode animal language.

programme.title: China's Greatest Treasures
programme.desc: Tea is a national drink in China. But it's far more than just a drink for Chinese people. Tea as a culture became fashionable in China during the Tang Dynasty. In this episode, British historian Alastair Sooke discovers how this simple drink has been transformed over centuries into an important social institution, and how it continues to be an essential part of Chinese culture today.

programme.title: The Big Cases
programme.desc: How the husband of Scotland's longest-serving first minister, Nicola Sturgeon, embezzled £400,000 from the party he ran - using a paper trail of lies to cover up a spending spree on luxury goods, from a motor home to coffee machines and even toilet seats. Peter Murrell was one of the most powerful figures in Scottish politics, operating away from the spotlight as chief executive of Scotland's ruling party. But behind the scenes, police pieced together a scandal - which ended in a dawn raid - involving hundreds of thousands of pounds in missing money. He pleaded guilty, while his estranged wife, the party's former leader, denied all knowledge. From the corridors of Holyrood to the highest ranks of the SNP, loyalties fractured as Mr Murrell's reputation collapsed. With insider testimony, analysis and extraordinary revelations from the case, this is a story of power, money and betrayal at the heart of modern Scottish politics.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: As governments and businesses confront their reliance on US tech giants, AI Decoded explores whether Britain can build its own AI future - and how quickly it must act. Now, a sudden decision from Washington is sending shockwaves through the global AI industry, restricting access to some of America's most advanced systems - even for its allies. For UK companies, it raises a stark question: what happens when the technology you depend on is no longer available? Presenter Marc Cieslak is joined by Yang Li of East London startup Cosine, now racing to build a 'sovereign' British alternative as demand surges following the US clampdown. Bloomberg's Katrina Manson also joins to unpack the national security stakes, alongside co-host Stephanie Hare.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as New Zealand play Belgium in their final Group G match at BC Place, Vancouver. The All Whites of New Zealand have failed to make it out of the group stage or win a match in their two previous appearances. They lost all three games in 1982 and drew all three in 2010. Their talisman is Nottingham Forest striker Chris Wood. Belgium enjoyed their best World Cup finish when they came third at the 2018 tournament in Russia, but they followed it up with a group stage exit in 2022. This will be their 15th appearance in the competition. No other European team has qualified for as many tournaments without winning the trophy. Their key players are likely to be Thibaut Courtois, Kevin De Bruyne and Romelu Lukaku.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team of comedians – Rosie Jones, Ed Byrne, Nabil Abdulrashid and Harriet Kemsley – as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: The Weakest Link

Celebrity contestants in this episode are Keith Duffy, Rachel Riley, Amy Gledhill, Ching He Huang, Konan, Rory Bremner, Bonnie Langford and Chris Harris.

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: The group have been kicked out of the villa, and Zoe’s disappearance prompts a frantic search. Nat’s co-dependency with Jacob is challenged when unexpected guests trigger an awkward run-in with the local police. Unable to face up to her actions, Zoe is on a dangerous quest for answers. What is her connection to this island? Can she ever go back to who she was? And even if she could, is it more important to be happy or good?

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: Zoe is looking to a future with Solomon, but her awakening seems to have deadly consequences as a wildfire threatens the island. Not everyone will make it home, and none of them can go back to who they were. Jacob can’t outrun his problems, and Nat must choose her future. Losing Zoe will drive Dan to take dangerous risks and force them both to confront the truth about who they are and what they want. Zoe will have to make a painful decision to step into her life anew.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team of comedians – Rosie Jones, Ed Byrne, Nabil Abdulrashid and Harriet Kemsley – as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as New Zealand play Belgium in their final Group G match at BC Place, Vancouver. The All Whites of New Zealand have failed to make it out of the group stage or win a match in their two previous appearances. They lost all three games in 1982 and drew all three in 2010. Their talisman is Nottingham Forest striker Chris Wood. Belgium enjoyed their best World Cup finish when they came third at the 2018 tournament in Russia, but they followed it up with a group stage exit in 2022. This will be their 15th appearance in the competition. No other European team has qualified for as many tournaments without winning the trophy. Their key players are likely to be Thibaut Courtois, Kevin De Bruyne and Romelu Lukaku.

programme.title: East Midlands Today
programme.desc: The latest news, sport and weather for the East Midlands.

programme.title: BBC Weather
programme.desc: The latest weather forecast.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team of comedians – Rosie Jones, Ed Byrne, Nabil Abdulrashid and Harriet Kemsley – as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Blankety Blank
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh hosts as a panel of six celebrities fill in the missing blanks and help win some brilliant prizes for some very lucky contestants. This week, he’s joined by Carol Vorderman, Clara Amfo, Johnny Vegas, Judi Love, Prue Leith and Asim Chaudhry.

programme.title: Pointless Celebrities
programme.desc: A celebrity special edition of the general knowledge quiz in which four teams try to come up with the answers that no-one else could think of. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and co-host Richard Osman and featuring Curtis Pritchard, AJ Pritchard, Tom Malone, Karim Zeroual, Shanaze Reade, Oli Bell, Fern Brady and Alison Spittle.

programme.title: The Weakest Link
programme.desc: Romesh Ranganathan is back quizzing eight celebrities who are all after a potential prize pot of £50,000 for their charity. Initially working together, the celebrities must vote off The Weakest Link each round until just two remain in the head-to-head. But only one can claim the prize. Celebrity contestants in this episode are Keith Duffy, Rachel Riley, Amy Gledhill, Ching He Huang, Konan, Rory Bremner, Bonnie Langford and Chris Harris.

programme.title: Casualty
programme.desc: In the aftermath of the complaint, can Dylan make things right with Stevie and Matty?

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: The group have been kicked out of the villa, and Zoe’s disappearance prompts a frantic search. Nat’s co-dependency with Jacob is challenged when unexpected guests trigger an awkward run-in with the local police. Unable to face up to her actions, Zoe is on a dangerous quest for answers. What is her connection to this island? Can she ever go back to who she was? And even if she could, is it more important to be happy or good?

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: Zoe is looking to a future with Solomon, but her awakening seems to have deadly consequences as a wildfire threatens the island. Not everyone will make it home, and none of them can go back to who they were. Jacob can’t outrun his problems, and Nat must choose her future. Losing Zoe will drive Dan to take dangerous risks and force them both to confront the truth about who they are and what they want. Zoe will have to make a painful decision to step into her life anew.

programme.title: BBC Weekend News
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: BBC Weather
programme.desc: The latest weather forecast.

programme.title: How Are You? It's Alan (Partridge)
programme.desc: Continuing his quest to fix the nation’s mind, Alan posits a question - does talking help, or is it better to just shut your mouth? - and uses it to help the meek speak.

programme.title: The Hit List
programme.desc: Marvin and Rochelle Humes host the compulsive, play-along music quiz. Contestants simply have to name hit songs and artists to win a possible £10,000, but can they stay cool under pressure? The teams are best friends Izzy and Ellie from Sheffield, husband and wife Joy and Joe from Nottingham, and dad and son Tom and Paul from Liverpool, all hoping to hit the right note and win a chance to bag that cash prize. Get ready to play along and shout out the answers at the telly!

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of Colombia against Portugal in Group J in Miami on the final day of group games. Portugal are at their seventh consecutive World Cup and reached the quarter-finals in Qatar four years ago. Forty-one-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo remains the talisman of manager Roberto Martinez’s squad, which also includes Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes. Colombia failed to qualify for Qatar 2022. Their best performance came in 2014, when they reached the quarter-finals, thanks to six goals from star midfielder James Rodriguez.

programme.title: Weather for the Week Ahead
programme.desc: Detailed weather forecast.

programme.title: Joins BBC News
programme.desc: BBC One joins the BBC's rolling news channel for a night of news.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as New Zealand play Belgium in their final Group G match at BC Place, Vancouver. The All Whites of New Zealand have failed to make it out of the group stage or win a match in their two previous appearances. They lost all three games in 1982 and drew all three in 2010. Their talisman is Nottingham Forest striker Chris Wood. Belgium enjoyed their best World Cup finish when they came third at the 2018 tournament in Russia, but they followed it up with a group stage exit in 2022. This will be their 15th appearance in the competition. No other European team has qualified for as many tournaments without winning the trophy. Their key players are likely to be Thibaut Courtois, Kevin De Bruyne and Romelu Lukaku.

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: The latest news, sport, business and weather from the BBC's Breakfast team.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt is joined by chefs Ben Lippett and Ravinder Bhogal, and by special guest Jesse Tyler Ferguson. Drinks expert Olly Smith picks the wines to go with the studio dishes, and there are some great moments from the BBC food archive.

programme.title: Anna Haugh’s Big Irish Food Tour
programme.desc: Anna visits the stunning Glens of Antrim, where garden designer Diarmuid Gavin spent magical family holidays as a child. He shows Anna a garden he created to celebrate the King’s coronation. They visit a Ballycastle farm growing Ireland's beloved potato, where they are put to work during potato-planting season. Further up the glen, Anna finds inspiration at Broughgammon Farm, which ensures a high quality of life for goats and calves otherwise discarded by the dairy industry.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A pink bathroom with brown carpeting in Coventry has Dion looking for a sledgehammer. He also visits Doncaster to look around a mid-terrace. Martel is just outside Newcastle, where there’s work to be done to bring another property up to date.

programme.desc: Live coverage of Colombia against Portugal in Group J in Miami on the final day of group games. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as New Zealand play Belgium in their final Group G match at BC Place, Vancouver. The All Whites of New Zealand have failed to make it out of the group stage or win a match in their two previous appearances. They lost all three games in 1982 and drew all three in 2010. Their talisman is Nottingham Forest striker Chris Wood. Belgium enjoyed their best World Cup finish when they came third at the 2018 tournament in Russia, but they followed it up with a group stage exit in 2022. This will be their 15th appearance in the competition. No other European team has qualified for as many tournaments without winning the trophy. Their key players are likely to be Thibaut Courtois, Kevin De Bruyne and Romelu Lukaku.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team of comedians – Rosie Jones, Ed Byrne, Nabil Abdulrashid and Harriet Kemsley – as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team of comedians – Rosie Jones, Ed Byrne, Nabil Abdulrashid and Harriet Kemsley – as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.desc: Live coverage as New Zealand play Belgium in their final Group G match at BC Place, Vancouver. programme.title: Escape to the Country

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: The squirrel family is one of the most widespread on earth, so what is the secret to their success? There are squirrels that can glide through the air, outwit rattlesnakes and survive the coldest temperatures of any mammal. We uncover the extraordinary abilities of these cheeky characters, putting their problem solving to the test on a specially designed assault course. We team up with some of the world's top squirrel scientists who are making groundbreaking discoveries - from the fox squirrel who can remember the location of 9,000 nuts to the grey squirrel whose tree-top leaps are the basis of new designs in robotics. We also see the world through the eyes of an orphan red squirrel called Billy, as he grows up and develops all the skills he will need to be released back to the wild. It is time to meet the animal family we should never underestimate - the supersquirrels.

programme.title: The Witches
programme.desc: A young boy and his grandmother have a run-in with a coven of witches and their leader. Based on the Roald Dahl novel.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek turns Pied Piper as he launches a walk of 800 children marking the anniversary of ‘People Power’ that saved a stretch of the Loughor Estuary for families to enjoy. On this Carmarthenshire coastal walk from Pwll to Kidwelly, the weatherman also discovers a former munitions factory that employed 6,000 people, has a spin in a racing car and learns the story of Wales’s feisty warrior princess Gwenllian.

The All Whites of New Zealand have failed to make it out of the group stage or win a match in their two previous appearances. They lost all three games in 1982 and drew all three in 2010. Their talisman is Nottingham Forest striker Chris Wood. Belgium enjoyed their best World Cup finish when they came third at the 2018 tournament in Russia, but they followed it up with a group stage exit in 2022. This will be their 15th appearance in the competition. No other European team has qualified for as many tournaments without winning the trophy. Their key players are likely to be Thibaut Courtois, Kevin De Bruyne and Romelu Lukaku.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team of comedians – Rosie Jones, Ed Byrne, Nabil Abdulrashid and Harriet Kemsley – as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: Zoe is looking to a future with Solomon, but her awakening seems to have deadly consequences as a wildfire threatens the island. Losing Zoe will drive Dan to take dangerous risks and force them both to confront the truth about who they are and what they want. Zoe will have to make a painful decision to step into her life anew.

programme.title: The Hit List
programme.desc: Marvin and Rochelle Humes host the compulsive, play-along music quiz. Contestants simply have to name hit songs and artists to win a possible £10,000, but can they stay cool under pressure? The teams are best friends Izzy and Ellie from Sheffield, husband and wife Joy and Joe from Nottingham, and dad and son Tom and Paul from Liverpool, all hoping to hit the right note and win a chance to bag that cash prize. Get ready to play along and shout out the answers at the telly!

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of Colombia against Portugal in Group J in Miami on the final day of group games. Portugal are at their seventh consecutive World Cup and reached the quarter-finals in Qatar four years ago. Forty-one-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo remains the talisman of manager Roberto Martinez’s squad, which also includes Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes. Colombia failed to qualify for Qatar 2022. Their best performance came in 2014, when they reached the quarter-finals, thanks to six goals from star midfielder James Rodriguez.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as New Zealand play Belgium in their final Group G match at BC Place, Vancouver. The All Whites of New Zealand have failed to make it out of the group stage or win a match in their two previous appearances. They lost all three games in 1982 and drew all three in 2010. Their talisman is Nottingham Forest striker Chris Wood. Belgium enjoyed their best World Cup finish when they came third at the 2018 tournament in Russia, but they followed it up with a group stage exit in 2022. This will be their 15th appearance in the competition. No other European team has qualified for as many tournaments without winning the trophy. Their key players are likely to be Thibaut Courtois, Kevin De Bruyne and Romelu Lukaku.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team of comedians – Rosie Jones, Ed Byrne, Nabil Abdulrashid and Harriet Kemsley – as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie, and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: Zoe is looking to a future with Solomon, but her awakening seems to have deadly consequences as a wildfire threatens the island. Losing Zoe will drive Dan to take dangerous risks and force them both to confront the truth about who they are and what they want. Zoe will have to make a painful decision to step into her life anew.

programme.title: The Agency: Unfiltered
programme.desc: Cherry has dropped into the agency’s office to deliver some news to Kirsten and Amy - she has been asked to perform a paid gig in Cyprus, so she is choosing to leave the academy in order to focus on paid work. Kirsten and Amy are disappointed to hear that she is leaving, as they think that she could have gone far in the competition, but they wish her the best and send her on her way!

programme.title: The Agency: Unfiltered
programme.desc: Kirsten and Amy have brought the academy competitors on an influencer trip to Tenerife, and the creators are in the middle of their third challenge to create content about the trip, which must include a reference to the trip’s sponsor, Stylink. Stylink representative Jack is on the trip, so he gets to witness first-hand how the competitors get on. In the middle of their day at the beach club, Amy is chatting to Nasti about how he is getting on, but she has discovered that he hasn’t done any research into the brand and doesn’t know what they do. Amy offers some advice and reminds him that it is Jack who will be judging this challenge. However, Nasti seems surprisingly resistant to her feedback. The challenge continues at a restaurant, where the competitors continue to film footage for their video. While they are at dinner, they also have the opportunity to ask Jack about the best way to impress him!

programme.title: Schitt's Creek

programme.title: Schitt's Creek
programme.desc: David agrees to go on a turkey hunt with Stevie and some local Creekers to show off his manliness. Things go badly when she ends up coming out looking just like Jocelyn. Alexis starts a relationship with the only normal man in Schitt’s Creek, the young veterinarian Ted.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: With Dermot and Maria's wedding just weeks away, the Brown household is in crisis. Agnes Brown's son Dermot wants to ask his childhood friend Buster to be best man. But Agnes has set her heart on Mark Brown, her eldest son, being Dermot's best man. And Buster is a crook, of whom both the strong-willed Maria and Mrs Brown strongly disapprove. On top of this, Mrs Brown's close friend and neighbour Winnie is distraught. Her husband Jacko has been rushed to hospital and cannot possibly afford to pay for the operation he urgently requires. And, needing cash for his wedding, Dermot has allowed himself to get embroiled in one of Buster's dodgy moneymaking scams. It's time for Mrs Brown to exercise all her diplomatic skills, starting with 'accidentally' letting Maria know all about Dermot's best man decision.

programme.title: Gods of Tennis
programme.desc: It’s 1990, and Martina Navratilova – Czech-born but representing the USA - has the chance to become the most decorated singles player in Wimbledon history. In comparison, her famous rival Chris Evert is America’s sweetheart. Evert is heralded as the perfect celebrity athlete, pigeonholed based on her looks, but she is Navratilova’s most formidable opponent, with a reputation for incredible mental toughness. This episode tells the story of their intense rivalry, but at the heart of the story is Navratilova’s search for acceptance – which culminates in an ambition to become the greatest player to ever grace Centre Court.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Egypt play their final Group G match against Iran in Seattle. In three previous attempts, Egypt have failed to make it past the first phase and lost all three of their group games when they last qualified for a World Cup back in 2018. Iran are at their fourth consecutive World Cup, having qualified on six occasions in total, but like their opponents, they are yet to contest a knockout game.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Football freestyle star Ben Nuttall goes head-to-head with a rising young champion in an epic skills battle that is packed with tricks and plenty of surprises! Joel sets out on a mission to become a superhero - the first two challenges he faces are flying and attempting to create his very own superhero costume!

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty is in full summer mode - revamping and refreshing borders to keep the garden looking its best right through the season. He turns his attention to the cucurbit family, planting melons and squash, shares a simple trick to extend the flowering of hardy geraniums, and sows perennial seeds for spectacular colour next year. Arit Anderson heads to south east London to discover the striking transformation of a garden that was once a derelict space into a bold, contemporary community garden powered by creativity, collaboration and clever planting. Rachel de Thame explores how self-seeding plants can be carefully choreographed to create a beautifully natural, flowing design. There’s a passionate grower dedicated to the National Collection of penstemons, and in the Yorkshire Dales, a florist and lifelong gardener shares a deeply personal story of resilience - finding strength, purpose and renewed creativity through rebuilding a garden after a life-changing diagnosis.

programme.title: Mr Malcolm's List
programme.desc: Spurned by one of society's wealthiest and most eligible bachelors, husband-seeking Julia Thistlewaite is outraged to discover she does not live up to Mr Malcolm's list of required attributes in a potential wife. Seeking revenge, she invites her best friend, the daughter of an impoverished clergyman, to ensnare Mr Malcolm.

programme.title: Andi Oliver’s Fabulous Feasts
programme.desc: Andi Oliver’s in Burnley to supersize an annual cricket match between members of the local mosques and clergy. Set up to overcome the divisions that led to race riots in 2001, Burnley’s imams and vicars have been staging the cricketing contest every year, building bridges between their communities. This year they want the event to be the biggest yet, with larger crowds and better food, showing that Burnley is a united town with a positive future. To make sure it’s a success, Andi wants to devise the ultimate cricket tea, sourcing the best local produce and tracking down talented chefs from the wonderfully diverse backgrounds that make up this old mill town. She also wants to add some razzmatazz to the event to draw in the crowds and ensure it's an event that appeals to all. But will her attempt to make this a premier date in the Lancashire cricketing calendar, galvanising Burnley folk for years to come, be stumped by an incoming storm?

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
programme.desc: Nigel Slater raids his cupboards, fridge and vegetable patch to create a week's worth of delicious meals. In this edition, he demonstrates how to make our ingredients go just that little bit further. Whether it's adding grated beetroot to make a tasty meatball supper feed the masses or putting the spotlight on a small garden harvest to make a sensuous pudding, Nigel's clever tricks and inspired ideas show that you can often make bountiful feasts with apparently few ingredients.

programme.title: The Railway Children
programme.desc: 1904, England. When their father is mysteriously arrested, the Waterbury children and their mother downsize and move to the Yorkshire countryside. Bobbie, Phyllis and Peter discover the local steam railway, and on their adventures, they befriend the station porter, Mr Perks, and try to discover the truth about their father. Lionel Jeffries's beloved film version of ES Nesbit's classic book.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog It! comes from Margam Country Park in South Wales. Experts Mark Stacey and Catherine Southon choose items to take to auction. Mark Stacey meets someone with an eye for a bargain and Catherine is taken by a wonderful pink rolls Royce! Presenter Paul Martin visits the birthplace of one of his heroes, a Welshman who took Hollywood by storm.

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
programme.desc: Out on a late night job alone, power repairman Roy Neary has an encounter with an alien spacecraft and becomes consumed with the desire to see it again. The government denies it, but other people have been seeing the UFOs and having strange experiences, too. Soon, Roy is on a one-way mission to expose the truth.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top ceramicist and star of The Great Pottery Throw Down Keith Brymer Jones takes on Esme Young, judge of The Great British Sewing Bee, in a competition to find the most profitable antique. Accompanied by antiques experts Roo Irvine and Charles Hanson, the celebrity competitors comb through some of Glasgow’s finest antique shops with a £400 budget and a classic car to take them between stops.

programme.title: Cricket: Today at the Test
programme.desc: Day 3 highlights from the third Test match between England and New Zealand.

programme.title: Glastonbury
programme.desc: With Glastonbury Festival taking a well-deserved fallow year break in 2026, this deep dive into the archives revisits 40 precious performances from Worthy Farm. This extended celebration spans from when the festival was first televised in 1994 right through to 2025, with appearances from the likes of Adele, Blondie, Blur, Dolly Parton, Elton John, Florence + The Machine, Johnny Cash, Kylie Minogue, Lizzo, Oasis, Olivia Rodrigo and Robert Smith, Paul McCartney, Pet Shop Boys, Pulp, REM, Radiohead, Robbie Williams, Stormzy, Sugababes and The Rolling Stones. Plus rarely seen performance footage of Amy Winehouse, Ed Sheeran and Olivia Dean.

programme.title: Glastonbury
programme.desc: Clara Amfo and Lauren Laverne are live from Worthy Farm to introduce 2025's Glastonbury Festival legend, pop rock icon Rod Stewart. The British singer, songwriter and producer, who celebrated another number one album last year, will step out onto the Pyramid Stage for the first time in over 20 years, having previously headlined the festival in 2002. With his trademark raspy, soulful voice and armed with a huge back catalogue of hits, there’s no doubt he will have the crowd singing along and swinging their hips to songs like Maggie May, You Wear It Well and Do Ya Think I’m Sexy? as he promises to entertain the Glastonbury teatime revellers.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as World Cup debutants Uzbekistan play their final Group K game against the Democratic Republic of Congo in Atlanta. Uzbekistan are managed by 2006 World Cup-winning captain Fabio Cannavaro, with Manchester City’s Abdukodir Khusanov in the centre of their defence. Last appearing in the 1974 World Cup as Zaire, the Democratic Republic of Congo enjoyed an impressive qualifying campaign for the 2026 tournament, drawing in Senegal before knocking out both Cameroon and Nigeria in the African play-offs.

There’s a passionate grower dedicated to the National Collection of penstemons, and in the Yorkshire Dales, a florist and lifelong gardener shares a deeply personal story of resilience - finding strength, purpose and renewed creativity through rebuilding a garden after a life-changing diagnosis.

programme.title: Mr Malcolm's List
programme.desc: Spurned by one of society's wealthiest and most eligible bachelors, husband-seeking Julia Thistlewaite is outraged to discover she does not live up to Mr Malcolm's list of required attributes in a potential wife. Seeking revenge, she invites her best friend, the daughter of an impoverished clergyman, to ensnare Mr Malcolm.

programme.title: Andi Oliver’s Fabulous Feasts
programme.desc: Andi Oliver’s in Burnley to supersize an annual cricket match between members of the local mosques and clergy. Set up to overcome the divisions that led to race riots in 2001, Burnley’s imams and vicars have been staging the cricketing contest every year, building bridges between their communities. This year they want the event to be the biggest yet, with larger crowds and better food, showing that Burnley is a united town with a positive future. To make sure it’s a success, Andi wants to devise the ultimate cricket tea, sourcing the best local produce and tracking down talented chefs from the wonderfully diverse backgrounds that make up this old mill town. She also wants to add some razzmatazz to the event to draw in the crowds and ensure it's an event that appeals to all. But will her attempt to make this a premier date in the Lancashire cricketing calendar, galvanising Burnley folk for years to come, be stumped by an incoming storm?

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
programme.desc: Nigel Slater raids his cupboards, fridge and vegetable patch to create a week's worth of delicious meals. In this edition, he demonstrates how to make our ingredients go just that little bit further. Whether it's adding grated beetroot to make a tasty meatball supper feed the masses or putting the spotlight on a small garden harvest to make a sensuous pudding, Nigel's clever tricks and inspired ideas show that you can often make bountiful feasts with apparently few ingredients.

programme.title: The Railway Children
programme.desc: 1904, England. When their father is mysteriously arrested, the Waterbury children and their mother downsize and move to the Yorkshire countryside. Bobbie, Phyllis and Peter discover the local steam railway, and on their adventures, they befriend the station porter, Mr Perks, and try to discover the truth about their father. Lionel Jeffries's beloved film version of ES Nesbit's classic book.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog It! comes from Margam Country Park in South Wales. Experts Mark Stacey and Catherine Southon choose items to take to auction. Mark Stacey meets someone with an eye for a bargain and Catherine is taken by a wonderful pink rolls Royce! Presenter Paul Martin visits the birthplace of one of his heroes, a Welshman who took Hollywood by storm.

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
programme.desc: Out on a late night job alone, power repairman Roy Neary has an encounter with an alien spacecraft and becomes consumed with the desire to see it again. The government denies it, but other people have been seeing the UFOs and having strange experiences, too. Soon, Roy is on a one-way mission to expose the truth.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top ceramicist and star of The Great Pottery Throw Down Keith Brymer Jones takes on Esme Young, judge of The Great British Sewing Bee, in a competition to find the most profitable antique. Accompanied by antiques experts Roo Irvine and Charles Hanson, the celebrity competitors comb through some of Glasgow’s finest antique shops with a £400 budget and a classic car to take them between stops.

programme.title: Cricket: Today at the Test
programme.desc: Day 3 highlights from the third Test match between England and New Zealand.

programme.title: Glastonbury
programme.desc: With Glastonbury Festival taking a well-deserved fallow year break in 2026, this deep dive into the archives revisits 40 precious performances from Worthy Farm. This extended celebration spans from when the festival was first televised in 1994 right through to 2025, with appearances from the likes of Adele, Blondie, Blur, Dolly Parton, Elton John, Florence + The Machine, Johnny Cash, Kylie Minogue, Lizzo, Oasis, Olivia Rodrigo and Robert Smith, Paul McCartney, Pet Shop Boys, Pulp, REM, Radiohead, Robbie Williams, Stormzy, Sugababes and The Rolling Stones. Plus rarely seen performance footage of Amy Winehouse, Ed Sheeran and Olivia Dean.

programme.title: Glastonbury
programme.desc: Clara Amfo and Lauren Laverne are live from Worthy Farm to introduce 2025's Glastonbury Festival legend, pop rock icon Rod Stewart. The British singer, songwriter and producer, who celebrated another number one album last year, will step out onto the Pyramid Stage for the first time in over 20 years, having previously headlined the festival in 2002. With his trademark raspy, soulful voice and armed with a huge back catalogue of hits, there’s no doubt he will have the crowd singing along and swinging their hips to songs like Maggie May, You Wear It Well and Do Ya Think I’m Sexy? as he promises to entertain the Glastonbury teatime revellers.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as World Cup debutants Uzbekistan play their final Group K game against the Democratic Republic of Congo in Atlanta. Uzbekistan are managed by 2006 World Cup-winning captain Fabio Cannavaro, with Manchester City’s Abdukodir Khusanov in the centre of their defence. Last appearing in the 1974 World Cup as Zaire, the Democratic Republic of Congo enjoyed an impressive qualifying campaign for the 2026 tournament, drawing in Senegal before knocking out both Cameroon and Nigeria in the African play-offs.

programme.title: Gods of Tennis
programme.desc: It’s 1990, and Martina Navratilova – Czech-born but representing the USA - has the chance to become the most decorated singles player in Wimbledon history. In comparison, her famous rival Chris Evert is America’s sweetheart. Evert is heralded as the perfect celebrity athlete, pigeonholed based on her looks, but she is Navratilova’s most formidable opponent, with a reputation for incredible mental toughness. This episode tells the story of their intense rivalry, but at the heart of the story is Navratilova’s search for acceptance – which culminates in an ambition to become the greatest player to ever grace Centre Court.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Egypt play their final Group G match against Iran in Seattle. In three previous attempts, Egypt have failed to make it past the first phase and lost all three of their group games when they last qualified for a World Cup back in 2018. Iran are at their fourth consecutive World Cup, having qualified on six occasions in total, but like their opponents, they are yet to contest a knockout game.

Bobbie, Phyllis and Peter discover the local steam railway, and on their adventures, they befriend the station porter, Mr Perks, and try to discover the truth about their father. Lionel Jeffries's beloved film version of ES Nesbit's classic book.

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
programme.desc: Out on a late night job alone, power repairman Roy Neary has an encounter with an alien spacecraft and becomes consumed with the desire to see it again. The government denies it, but other people have been seeing the UFOs and having strange experiences, too. Soon, Roy is on a one-way mission to expose the truth.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and his team of experts invite members of the public to bring their antiques to be viewed and valued, with an option to sell at auction.

programme.title: Springwatch in Wales
programme.desc: Iolo Williams looks back on the best Springwatch stories featuring changes to Welsh wildlife and celebrates the conservationists giving back to nature. Gillian Burke visits Gwaith Powdwr, an explosives factory transformed into a wildlife oasis. Iolo recounts stories of two Arctic visitors - from Wally the Walrus, who unexpectedly turned up in Tenby, to the dedicated effort to monitor the vulnerable Greenland white-fronted geese who overwinter in Wales. Gillian visits a loyal birdwatcher who discusses changes the River Tiefi has revealed over decades, while researchers at Bangor University follow a surprising reptile introduced to Wales. Iolo recounts his early involvement in the pine marten reintroduction projects in Wales and how they wouldn’t have been possible without an army of conservationists.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top ceramicist and star of The Great Pottery Throw Down Keith Brymer Jones takes on Esme Young, judge of The Great British Sewing Bee, in a competition to find the most profitable antique. Accompanied by antiques experts Roo Irvine and Charles Hanson, the celebrity competitors comb through some of Glasgow’s finest antique shops with a £400 budget and a classic car to take them between stops.

programme.title: Cricket: Today at the Test
programme.desc: Day 3 highlights from the third Test match between England and New Zealand.

programme.title: Glastonbury
programme.desc: With Glastonbury Festival taking a well-deserved fallow year break in 2026, this deep dive into the archives revisits 40 precious performances from Worthy Farm. This extended celebration spans from when the festival was first televised in 1994 right through to 2025, with appearances from the likes of Adele, Blondie, Blur, Dolly Parton, Elton John, Florence + The Machine, Johnny Cash, Kylie Minogue, Lizzo, Oasis, Olivia Rodrigo and Robert Smith, Paul McCartney, Pet Shop Boys, Pulp, REM, Radiohead, Robbie Williams, Stormzy, Sugababes and The Rolling Stones. Plus rarely seen performance footage of Amy Winehouse, Ed Sheeran and Olivia Dean.

programme.title: Glastonbury
programme.desc: Clara Amfo and Lauren Laverne are live from Worthy Farm to introduce 2025's Glastonbury Festival legend, pop rock icon Rod Stewart. The British singer, songwriter and producer, who celebrated another number one album last year, will step out onto the Pyramid Stage for the first time in over 20 years, having previously headlined the festival in 2002. With his trademark raspy, soulful voice and armed with a huge back catalogue of hits, there’s no doubt he will have the crowd singing along and swinging their hips to songs like Maggie May, You Wear It Well and Do Ya Think I’m Sexy? as he promises to entertain the Glastonbury teatime revellers.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as World Cup debutants Uzbekistan play their final Group K game against the Democratic Republic of Congo in Atlanta. Uzbekistan are managed by 2006 World Cup-winning captain Fabio Cannavaro, with Manchester City’s Abdukodir Khusanov in the centre of their defence. Last appearing in the 1974 World Cup as Zaire, the Democratic Republic of Congo enjoyed an impressive qualifying campaign for the 2026 tournament, drawing in Senegal before knocking out both Cameroon and Nigeria in the African play-offs.

programme.title: Gods of Tennis
programme.desc: It’s 1990, and Martina Navratilova – Czech-born but representing the USA - has the chance to become the most decorated singles player in Wimbledon history. In comparison, her famous rival Chris Evert is America’s sweetheart. Evert is heralded as the perfect celebrity athlete, pigeonholed based on her looks, but she is Navratilova’s most formidable opponent, with a reputation for incredible mental toughness. This episode tells the story of their intense rivalry, but at the heart of the story is Navratilova’s search for acceptance – which culminates in an ambition to become the greatest player to ever grace Centre Court.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Egypt play their final Group G match against Iran in Seattle. In three previous attempts, Egypt have failed to make it past the first phase and lost all three of their group games when they last qualified for a World Cup back in 2018. Iran are at their fourth consecutive World Cup, having qualified on six occasions in total, but like their opponents, they are yet to contest a knockout game.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Football freestyle star Ben Nuttall goes head-to-head with a rising young champion in an epic skills battle that is packed with tricks and plenty of surprises! Joel sets out on a mission to become a superhero - the first two challenges he faces are flying and attempting to create his very own superhero costume!

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty is in full summer mode - revamping and refreshing borders to keep the garden looking its best right through the season. He turns his attention to the cucurbit family, planting melons and squash, shares a simple trick to extend the flowering of hardy geraniums, and sows perennial seeds for spectacular colour next year. Arit Anderson heads to south east London to discover the striking transformation of a garden that was once a derelict space into a bold, contemporary community garden powered by creativity, collaboration and clever planting. Rachel de Thame explores how self-seeding plants can be carefully choreographed to create a beautifully natural, flowing design. There’s a passionate grower dedicated to the National Collection of penstemons, and in the Yorkshire Dales, a florist and lifelong gardener shares a deeply personal story of resilience - finding strength, purpose and renewed creativity through rebuilding a garden after a life-changing diagnosis.

programme.title: Mr Malcolm's List
programme.desc: Spurned by one of society's wealthiest and most eligible bachelors, husband-seeking Julia Thistlewaite is outraged to discover she does not live up to Mr Malcolm's list of required attributes in a potential wife. Seeking revenge, she invites her best friend, the daughter of an impoverished clergyman, to ensnare Mr Malcolm.

programme.title: Andi Oliver’s Fabulous Feasts
programme.desc: Andi Oliver’s in Burnley to supersize an annual cricket match between members of the local mosques and clergy. Set up to overcome the divisions that led to race riots in 2001, Burnley’s imams and vicars have been staging the cricketing contest every year, building bridges between their communities. This year they want the event to be the biggest yet, with larger crowds and better food, showing that Burnley is a united town with a positive future. To make sure it’s a success, Andi wants to devise the ultimate cricket tea, sourcing the best local produce and tracking down talented chefs from the wonderfully diverse backgrounds that make up this old mill town. She also wants to add some razzmatazz to the event to draw in the crowds and ensure it's an event that appeals to all. But will her attempt to make this a premier date in the Lancashire cricketing calendar, galvanising Burnley folk for years to come, be stumped by an incoming storm?

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
programme.desc: Nigel Slater raids his cupboards, fridge and vegetable patch to create a week's worth of delicious meals. In this edition, he demonstrates how to make our ingredients go just that little bit further. Whether it's adding grated beetroot to make a tasty meatball supper feed the masses or putting the spotlight on a small garden harvest to make a sensuous pudding, Nigel's clever tricks and inspired ideas show that you can often make bountiful feasts with apparently few ingredients.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the Peas get trapped in an underwater cave with a pack of inflated Lycheemodus!

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Chilli farmer Amrit Madhoo and the Fact Pack explore the colourful world of chillies. They discover how they grow, how ladybirds help protect the plants, and why not all chillies are spicy.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted and his family visit a wildlife park, and Ted gets to be an animal keeper for the day. First, he feeds the hungry deer. They’re very friendly. Next, it’s onto the bison, who show Ted their giant tongues! Finally, Ted comes face to face with a very noisy and very hungry otter. Luckily, Ted speaks otter too!

programme.title: Stan Can
programme.desc: Benjamin loses his Wondervole toy and can't sleep without it. Can Stan help?

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: The Game Catchers are a team of five friends on an interstellar journey to explore fantastic planets, with the aim of learning about and playing new games. The discovered games are collected into a database to make sure they are never lost.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Learn how much fun counting can be with the Numberblocks - a fun-loving group of numbers who work together to solve problems big and small.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: The Colourblocks attempt to solve a rainbow puzzle with the help of new friends Indigo and Violet. Learn about the seven colours of the rainbow with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca and Murphi are trying to come up with a new move to perfect their competition dance routine. They take a break for an ice-cold monster shake and find time to create a bottle penguin. The Mini Monsters demonstrate how to make everlasting sandcastles, and Rebecca’s aunt calls from space - where she has made some alien friends. The Recycling Express arrives with empty tissue boxes, inspiring a mega monster make – a funny pineapple puppet.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: The Froglets try gardening, but can they grow a beautiful flower before everyone returns?

programme.title: Get Set Galactic
programme.desc: Two teams take on three scientific challenges based on heavier or lighter, the human body and gravity. James makes a nature documentary about microscopic water bears.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children craft paper plate sheep with cotton wool, learn British Sign Language signs for little, lamb and snow, then sing and sign Mary Had a Little Lamb.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: Nick has fallen off his skateboard and hurt his wrist. How will he play his guitar to write today’s Popcast song? Norman and the Popcast Planners come up with the perfect plan and find lots of things in common on the way.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When her brother has a stomach bug, Pippen is afraid she will catch it because she doesn’t like bugs! Vida teaches her how to feel better - and that it’s not a real bug.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: When Mara calls Pearl sensible, she wants to prove how fun she is. With her eye off the ball, Pearl starts to make medical mistakes. Can she be a fun doctor?

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi and Ruby are having the best play date ever, and they don't want Ruby to go home, so they make a wish to be stuck together. At first, it’s funny - they eat, play and do homework side by side. But soon their different ideas cause squabbles. With help from Jake and Dash, they remember why they wanted to stay together in the first place. Even best friends have differences, and that’s what makes them special.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey and Bingo visit Grandad, he takes them on an adventure into the bush.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay
programme.desc: Jay gets turmeric on his hands and turns everything yellow! What if the whole world turns yellow because of his turmeric superpower?

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. When Duck gets frustrated with his new computer game, Sarah builds a version he can play.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: Children's animation. A brother and sister deal with problems that affect their everyday lives. Lola is in a superstitious mood. There are so many unlucky things you can do. Charlie plays along with this, but Lola's imagination gets carried away. If you step on the cracks, do bears really jump out at you? Or is it crocodiles? Or maybe lions? How can Charlie persuade Lola that some of these things are simply not true?

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: Colly Wobble finds an Upside-Down crown in the curiosity box, and decides to play at being the Upside-Down Princess. In Storyland, everybody visits the extraordinary Upside-Down Castle for a comical Upside-Down tea with the Upside-Down Princess.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa water a flower and give some thirsty Tweeties a drink too. At Play Time, they play with a present wrapped in flower petals and take turns unwrapping it, revealing a new layer of petal wrapping each time. At Yummy Time, they use petals as napkins. They bring the present to the Bay of Books, where they remove the final wrapping and reveal a wonderful surprise just in time for Storytime.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Igglepiggle is enjoying dancing in the garden. He leaves his blanket in a safe place, but when he returns, it is gone. Igglepiggle's blanket has landed on Makka Pakka and seems to be running about by itself.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Leah Williamson shouts loud and proud about girls being able to do anything!

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team reveal how adding water can transform any size of garden by creating two incredible water gardens, one outside and one inside - while Alan, Frances Tophill and David Domoney build a stunning outdoor space in a small plot featuring three different but equally spectacular water features for the Peacock family, whose small garden is young and featureless, in Kent, Katie Rushworth reveals how to build an indoor water feature that can transform a bare corner of your home. The Peacocks' young daughter Lily loves splashing around in water, so Alan creates an integrated seating area with a built-in waterfall in one corner by cleverly redesigning the space and tasks Frances with building a beautiful focal point using a free standing sheet of water surrounded by lush plants - however, the cleverest trick of all is David's archway over the path which doubles as a water sheet for the kids to run through and enjoy.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary arrives in Sligo, Yeats country, where the mountains, sea and sky feel like they've barely changed since the poet put them into verse. Local guide Tracey brings that world to life, tracing Yeats' Irish-English existence and the places that shaped him. From there, Dermot heads out onto the bay with Glen and Aisling of Sligo Oysters, getting his hands dirty on a working oyster farm before cooking the catch over an open flame on the shore. In Sligo town, he meets man-of-the-town chef Anthony Gray, who leads him through two of its most treasured food institutions: Clarke's, a family butcher of long standing, and Cosgrove & Sons, a provisions store that looks and feels like it hasn't changed in a century. With their haul gathered, Anthony and Dermot head to his flagship restaurant Eala Bán, where they cook up a proudly Irish Surf 'N' Turf.

With their haul gathered, Anthony and Dermot head to his flagship restaurant Eala Bán, where they cook up a proudly Irish Surf 'N' Turf.

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team reveal how adding water can transform any size of garden by creating two incredible water gardens, one outside and one inside - while Alan, Frances Tophill and David Domoney build a stunning outdoor space in a small plot featuring three different but equally spectacular water features for the Peacock family, whose small garden is young and featureless, in Kent, Katie Rushworth reveals how to build an indoor water feature that can transform a bare corner of your home. The Peacocks' young daughter Lily loves splashing around in water, so Alan creates an integrated seating area with a built-in waterfall in one corner by cleverly redesigning the space and tasks Frances with building a beautiful focal point using a free standing sheet of water surrounded by lush plants - however, the cleverest trick of all is David's archway over the path which doubles as a water sheet for the kids to run through and enjoy.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary arrives in Sligo, Yeats country, where the mountains, sea and sky feel like they've barely changed since the poet put them into verse. Local guide Tracey brings that world to life, tracing Yeats' Irish-English existence and the places that shaped him. From there, Dermot heads out onto the bay with Glen and Aisling of Sligo Oysters, getting his hands dirty on a working oyster farm before cooking the catch over an open flame on the shore. In Sligo town, he meets man-of-the-town chef Anthony Gray, who leads him through two of its most treasured food institutions: Clarke's, a family butcher of long standing, and Cosgrove & Sons, a provisions store that looks and feels like it hasn't changed in a century. With their haul gathered, Anthony and Dermot head to his flagship restaurant Eala Bán, where they cook up a proudly Irish Surf 'N' Turf.

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team reveal how adding water can transform any size of garden by creating two incredible water gardens, one outside and one inside - while Alan, Frances Tophill and David Domoney build a stunning outdoor space in a small plot featuring three different but equally spectacular water features for the Peacock family, whose small garden is young and featureless, in Kent, Katie Rushworth reveals how to build an indoor water feature that can transform a bare corner of your home. The Peacocks' young daughter Lily loves splashing around in water, so Alan creates an integrated seating area with a built-in waterfall in one corner by cleverly redesigning the space and tasks Frances with building a beautiful focal point using a free standing sheet of water surrounded by lush plants - however, the cleverest trick of all is David's archway over the path which doubles as a water sheet for the kids to run through and enjoy.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary arrives in Sligo, Yeats country, where the mountains, sea and sky feel like they've barely changed since the poet put them into verse. Local guide Tracey brings that world to life, tracing Yeats' Irish-English existence and the places that shaped him. From there, Dermot heads out onto the bay with Glen and Aisling of Sligo Oysters, getting his hands dirty on a working oyster farm before cooking the catch over an open flame on the shore. In Sligo town, he meets man-of-the-town chef Anthony Gray, who leads him through two of its most treasured food institutions: Clarke's, a family butcher of long standing, and Cosgrove & Sons, a provisions store that looks and feels like it hasn't changed in a century. With their haul gathered, Anthony and Dermot head to his flagship restaurant Eala Bán, where they cook up a proudly Irish Surf 'N' Turf.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: Well-travelled chef James Martin gets underneath the skin of Spain, a country he hardly knows but is excited to explore, as he discovers its history and culture in this series. In this episode, James visits a huge indoor food market in Bilbao, takes a funicular to a famous steak restaurant, and heads to a winery on a seabed - we also see how La Carolina is made as James cooks cod, squid ink arancini, Basque cheesecake and seafood on a boat.

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team reveal how adding water can transform any size of garden by creating two incredible water gardens, one outside and one inside - while Alan, Frances Tophill and David Domoney build a stunning outdoor space in a small plot featuring three different but equally spectacular water features for the Peacock family, whose small garden is young and featureless, in Kent, Katie Rushworth reveals how to build an indoor water feature that can transform a bare corner of your home. The Peacocks' young daughter Lily loves splashing around in water, so Alan creates an integrated seating area with a built-in waterfall in one corner by cleverly redesigning the space and tasks Frances with building a beautiful focal point using a free standing sheet of water surrounded by lush plants - however, the cleverest trick of all is David's archway over the path which doubles as a water sheet for the kids to run through and enjoy.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary arrives in Sligo, Yeats country, where the mountains, sea and sky feel like they've barely changed since the poet put them into verse. Local guide Tracey brings that world to life, tracing Yeats' Irish-English existence and the places that shaped him. From there, Dermot heads out onto the bay with Glen and Aisling of Sligo Oysters, getting his hands dirty on a working oyster farm before cooking the catch over an open flame on the shore. In Sligo town, he meets man-of-the-town chef Anthony Gray, who leads him through two of its most treasured food institutions: Clarke's, a family butcher of long standing, and Cosgrove & Sons, a provisions store that looks and feels like it hasn't changed in a century. With their haul gathered, Anthony and Dermot head to his flagship restaurant Eala Bán, where they cook up a proudly Irish Surf 'N' Turf.

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team reveal how adding water can transform any size of garden by creating two incredible water gardens, one outside and one inside - while Alan, Frances Tophill and David Domoney build a stunning outdoor space in a small plot featuring three different but equally spectacular water features for the Peacock family, whose small garden is young and featureless, in Kent, Katie Rushworth reveals how to build an indoor water feature that can transform a bare corner of your home. The Peacocks' young daughter Lily loves splashing around in water, so Alan creates an integrated seating area with a built-in waterfall in one corner by cleverly redesigning the space and tasks Frances with building a beautiful focal point using a free standing sheet of water surrounded by lush plants - however, the cleverest trick of all is David's archway over the path which doubles as a water sheet for the kids to run through and enjoy.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary arrives in Sligo, Yeats country, where the mountains, sea and sky feel like they've barely changed since the poet put them into verse. Local guide Tracey brings that world to life, tracing Yeats' Irish-English existence and the places that shaped him. From there, Dermot heads out onto the bay with Glen and Aisling of Sligo Oysters, getting his hands dirty on a working oyster farm before cooking the catch over an open flame on the shore. In Sligo town, he meets man-of-the-town chef Anthony Gray, who leads him through two of its most treasured food institutions: Clarke's, a family butcher of long standing, and Cosgrove & Sons, a provisions store that looks and feels like it hasn't changed in a century. With their haul gathered, Anthony and Dermot head to his flagship restaurant Eala Bán, where they cook up a proudly Irish Surf 'N' Turf.

programme.title: Likely Lads: Whatever Happened?

programme.desc: Gary returns to the bar to begin courting Phoebe, where he runs into her husband Donald. S1 E2: Fools Rush In

programme.title: Goodnight Sweetheart
programme.desc: Gary arouses suspicions when he saves Phoebe from an early evening bombing raid. S1 E3: Is Your Journey Really Necessary?

programme.desc: Ron agrees to help Gary return to 1940 but insists he go with him, and Phoebe loses half her belongings in a bombing. S1 E4: The More I See You

programme.desc: Gary believes that he married Phoebe after learning of an elderly woman name Phoebe Sparrow. S1 E5: I Get Along Without You Very Well

programme.title: Oh Doctor Beeching!
programme.desc: The workers of Hatley rail station live a gentle, predictable life, but that is rudely interrupted by some alarming news - and a new station master. S1 E1: All Change

programme.title: Oh Doctor Beeching!
programme.desc: Harry the signalman has fattened up a lovely turkey in time for Christmas, but the turkey seems to have other plans. S1 E2: Talking Turkey

programme.title: Oh Doctor Beeching!
programme.desc: New station master Cecil Parkin is intent on making an impression at Hatley, but Jack is sure that he's already made an impression on his wife May. S1 E3: The Train Now Standing...

programme.title: Oh Doctor Beeching!
programme.desc: The station staff are ready to help Cecil move into the station master's house. May has a confession to make and shares it with Ethel - but will she tell Jack?. S1 E4: A Moving Story

programme.title: Oh Doctor Beeching!
programme.desc: Harry Lambert has been on duty all night in the signal box. The delivery of a body causes problems - should it be classed as freight or passenger? S1 E5: The Late Mr Buckly

programme.title: Oh Doctor Beeching!
programme.desc: A horsebox belonging to Lady Lawrence is delivered to the station, and Wilfred is on hand with the essentials. Meanwhile, Harry's signal box seems to be on fire. S1 E6: Horse Play

programme.title: Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Sharon's living back in her council flat and Tracey's still in Chigwell with younger son Travis, but what's become of Dorien? What can bring the Birds back together? S10 E1: Gimme Shelter

programme.title: Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Sharon finds that looking after Dorien's every wish is a full time job - and with money tight, Sharon and Tracey take Dorien's designer clothes to a car boot sale to raise funds. S10 E2: Slave

programme.title: Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Garth and Marcie aren't getting any "together time" so it's all change in the bedrooms again. Sharon tries to bed down in the loft, where she makes an unexpected discovery. S10 E3: Hot Stuff

programme.title: Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Tracey, Sharon and Dorien each get romantically involved with three very different men, and Travis has romantic troubles of his own. S10 E4: Hearts For Sale

programme.title: Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Tracey becomes self-conscious about her appearance and has Botox, Travis has a tattoo to impress a girl at school and Sharon looks as if she'll need a hearing aid. S10 E5: Tattoo You

programme.title: Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Sharon gets a visit from estranged husband Chris, seeking a quick divorce so that he can marry his new love Angie, a blind woman, but Tracey has a few doubts. S10 E6: Blinded By Love

programme.title: Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Sharon, Tracey and Dorien all lose their jobs and the resulting financial crisis leads to a huge row. Some home truths are revealed and the three of them hit rock bottom. S10 E7: Back To Zero

programme.desc: When Arthur's GP orders him to cut down on booze and cigars, his grip on reality is called into question after he demands police protection from an angry customer. S8 E6: The Last Temptation of Daley
